services.name: Batting Cage (1 Hour)
services.desc: Pitching machines and full-length cages in Kitchener - open 24/7 and bookable online. Keep your swing sharp all year at CricNets. Our indoor cages pair a proper hitting surface with adjustable pitching machines, so youth players, rec-league hitters and competitive ballplayers can all get quality reps regardless of the weather or the hour. A machine that repeats the same pitch is the fastest way to fix timing and contact. Set the speed, take a bucket of swings, then change it up to work on adjusting - all without needing a partner to throw. services.name: Regular Lane
services.desc: Full-length lanes + bowling machines in Kitchener - open 24/7 and bookable online in under a minute. CricNets is Kitchener's dedicated indoor cricket centre on Queen Street South. Train on full-length turf lanes with professional bowling machines, run team practice, or grab a late-night hit - the doors open 24 hours a day with a secure access code, and everything is booked and paid online. Every lane is full length with quality turf, high ceilings and proper run-up space, so batting and bowling feel the same as they do outdoors.
